newsitem.title: USA: Rush CEO sees H2 rise in finance revenues.
newsitem.headline: Rush CEO sees H2 rise in finance revenues.

text.p: Rush Enterprises Inc said on Monday it sees finance revenues rising in the second half of 1997.

Marvin Rush, chairman and chief executive officer, said in a statement, "We believe finance revenues have stabilized and will begin to increase as the truck market improves during the second half of the year."

Rush added, "Earnings through the second quarter (ended June 30) were particularly affected by a decrease in finance income. Finance revenues have limited direct costs and, therefore, contribute a disproportionate share of operating profits."
"We remain committed to the trucking and equipment industries and are optimistic as to the prospects for the remainder of the year," Rush concluded.
Rush operates regional chain of one-stop truck sales and service centers.
